## Documentation checklist

- [ ] README checked/updated if current behavior or baseline changed
- [ ] ROADMAP checked/updated if milestone state changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG checked/updated for release/main behavior changes
- [ ] ARCHITECTURE checked/updated if control flow, state or invariants changed
- [ ] SECURITY checked/updated if trust/safety boundaries changed
- [ ] Historical acceptance docs remain snapshots, not live dashboards
- [ ] Production SHA/release is documented only after real deploy + health check
- [ ] No stale `pending` / `not deployed` / `next` / `current` statement remains

See `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`.
